title: [FEATURE] Claude in Chrome with API usage billing
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

`$ claude --chrome` -> `Claude in Chrome requires a claude.ai subscription`

We configured/use "API usage billing" where it's probably not allowed to use this feature.


### Proposed Solution

Enable this feature when "API usage billing" is configured
